title: Mixing: London Town, Café On The Left Bank by Wings | 1978
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Wings’ first studio session of 1978 took place on 4 January, when stereo mixes of two songs were created for the London Town album.

The songs were ‘London Town’ and ‘Cafe On The Left Bank’. However, although this day’s mixes were used on the album, Paul McCartney unsuccessfully attempted to remix the latter song the following day.
